const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); const content = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content="true"]'); const cr = content.getBoundingClientRect(); const scale = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--font-scale').trim(); const labelFont = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(label).fontSize); if (scale !== '1.25') throw new Error('字号没有切到 125%: ' + scale); if (Math.abs(docFont - 20) > 0.1) throw new Error('125% 下根字号不是 20px: ' + docFont); if (root && root.scrollWidth > root.clientWidth + 1) throw new Error('125% 下出现横向滚动: ' + root.scrollWidth + '>' + root.clientWidth); const overflow = [...content.querySelectorAll('*')].filter((el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); const content = document.querySelector('[data-settings-content="true"]'); const cr = content.getBoundingClientRect(); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-content="true"] [data-setting-row]')]; const heights = rows.map((r) => Math.round(r.getBoundingClientRect().height)); const minRow = Math.min(...heights); if (minRow < 55) throw new Error('125% 下设置行没有同比变高，最小行高 ' + minRow); const groups = new Map(); for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-content="true"] [data-setting-slot="true"]')) { const row = el.closest('[data-setting-row]'); const rr = row ? row.getBoundingClientRect() : null; const key = rr ? Math.round(rr.left) + '/' + Math.round(rr.right) : '0'; if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []); groups.get(key).push(Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().right)); } let spread = 0; for (const rights of groups.values()) { if (rights.length > 1) spread = Math.max(spread, Math.max(...rights) - Math.min(...rights)); } if (spread > 1) throw new Error('125% 下同列控件右缘不齐: ' + spread + 'px'); if (root.scrollWidth > root.clientWidth + 1) throw new Error('125% 下出现横向滚动: ' + root.scrollWidth + '>' + root.clientWidth); return { rows: rows.length, minRow, spread, columns: groups.size, contentWidth: Math.round(cr.width), overflowX: root.scrollWidth - root.clientWidth }; })()
